description: Beam analysis with report in English
message: Analyze a simply supported beam, span 7.5m, with an 18kN/m downward UDL over the full span. Discretize the beam at midspan with a connected analysis node, report the midspan vertical deflection, and generate a calculation report.

assertions.description: The report markdown must faithfully reflect the current model, loads, and analysis artifact, explicitly include the requested midspan vertical deflection, contain no numerical value or engineering conclusion inconsistent with the current artifacts, and make no unsupported structural-safety or code-compliance claim.
